title: E2AP: Const-ify ran_function_dissector_t instances.
description:
These ran_function_dissector_t structures appear to be never written at
runtime, so let's make them (and a few other nearby variables) "const".

Moves 12.4 kBytes of data from a read-write section to a read-only section.
